an10.115:1.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.115:1.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.115:1.5: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an10.115:2.1: athakho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi
an10.115:2.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:2.3: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.115:2.5: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.115:2.6: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti
an10.115:3.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.115:3.3: pahoti āyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
an10.115:3.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.115:3.5: yathā no āyasmā ānando byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāressāmāti
an10.115:4.1: athakho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
an10.115:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ
an10.115:5.1: idaṃ kho āvuso ānanda bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:5.2: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:6.1: tesaṃ no āvuso amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi
an10.115:6.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:6.3: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.115:6.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti
an10.115:7.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.115:7.3: pahoti āyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
an10.115:7.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamissāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.115:7.5: yathā no āyasmā ānando byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāreyyāmāti
an10.115:8.1: seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlaṃ atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya
an10.115:8.2: evaṃ sampadamidaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha
an10.115:8.3: so āvuso bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammasāmī tathāgato
an10.115:8.4: so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ tumhe bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha
an10.115:8.5: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
an10.115:9.1: addhāvuso ānanda bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammasāmī tathāgato
an10.115:9.2: so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ mayaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.115:9.3: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma
an10.115:9.4: apicāyasmā ānando satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.115:9.5: pahoti āyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
an10.115:10.2: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.115:11.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.115:11.2: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.115:11.4: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti.

an10.115:13.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho
an10.115:15.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho

an10.115:16.2: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho

an10.115:16.4: ākaṃkhamānā ca pana tumhe āvuso bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha
an10.115:16.5: yathā no bhagavā byākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.

an10.115:19.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti

an10.115:20.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma

an10.115:21.1: athakho mayaṃ bhante yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamimhā upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ apucchimhā

an10.115:22.4: maṃ cepi tumhe bhikkhave upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha ahampicetaṃ evameva byākareyyaṃ yathātaṃ ānandena byākataṃ
an10.115:22.5: eso ceva tassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
